question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct}, negative, so cash runs ahead of income. Against the company's own history the cushion is thinner: the ratio is below each of the last four fiscal years ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}) and above only fiscal 2021 and 2020 ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}); the accruals ratio stays close to fiscal 2025's {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, the most cash-backed of the five filled years. Part of the narrowing is non-cash income: this quarter's net income carries an unrealized gain on newly listed equity that the cash-flow statement takes back out. The latest quarter is the weak point: operating cash flow of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.0} sits close to net income of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0}, operating cash flow changed {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} sequentially while net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, and the quarterly accruals cell cannot be computed. Working capital over the year: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income, and inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}; payables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}, offsetting much of that absorption, so trade working capital moved only from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now}. MD&A attributes the payables rise to timing of payment obligations, which implies it reverses. Articulation: receivables ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}) and inventory ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}) tie to the cash-flow statement; payables leave a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}, the balance sheet rising more than operations are credited with. That reads as non-operating payables, such as capital-expenditure accruals while property and equipment rose sharply. A gap in that direction does not inflate operating cash flow, but neither report names its cause. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, below one, so income moves less than cash; the calculator holds no history of the measure, and the plain reading is lumpy working capital in a fast-growing hardware business.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Cash-backed over the trailing year, but with a thinner cushion than in each of the last four fiscal years; in the latest quarter operating cash flow barely covers net income and leans on a payables build that the company calls timing.

revenue_recognition.finding: Year over year, receivables are not outrunning revenue. Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the second lowest of the six filled quarters and below the year-ago quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, while quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. The annual measure fell from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and the trailing average-based measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. Quarter over quarter, though, it rose from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest quarter. Receivables absorbed cash this quarter, where a year earlier they released it. MD&A attributes the six-month rise to higher revenue, and the year-over-year measure supports that; the sequential uptick is the part revenue alone does not explain. Contract liabilities and deferred revenue are untagged in every period, so deferred revenue moving against revenue cannot be tested. The notes reader found no change in revenue-policy wording. A new judgment area is forming: OpenAI and Meta hold warrants that vest on Instinct GPU purchase milestones and stock-price targets. None had vested at quarter end, and they will be classified as liabilities when they do. Equity granted to a customer in step with its purchases is consideration payable to a customer, so it may reduce the revenue recognised on those sales. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested because the trend table has no derived fourth-quarter cells. Neither report mentions extended payment terms or bill-and-hold.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Clean year over year: receivables grew more slowly than revenue. The open points are a sequential rise in days sales outstanding, untestable deferred revenue and fourth-quarter timing, and a forthcoming customer-warrant judgment that can reduce recognised revenue.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance and inventory-reserve ratios are filled in no period, and the trailing inventory write-down field is missing, so thinning reserves cannot be tested. The warranty accrual ratio rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} in fiscal 2025, the highest of five years, from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}. A thickening reserve is conservative, but it signals rising product exposure, and nothing shows the accrual after year end. Gross margin is the highest of six quarters at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, measured against a year-ago base that carried the export-control inventory charge. With no reserve history visible, the numbers cannot show whether any previously written-down product was sold later, which would lift margin; MD&A names only the absence of the charge and a favourable mix. Taxes: the trailing rate of {tax_rate|pct} excludes the prior-year reserve release. Even so, fiscal 2025 net income of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.net_income} exceeded operating income of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_income}, helped by releasing uncertain-tax-position reserves after IRS relief on dual consolidated losses, and unrecognized tax benefits fell during fiscal 2025; that discrete item raised prior-year income. This quarter's GAAP tax rate sits below the release's non-GAAP rate. Several estimates now run through income. Other income includes unrealized gains on equity that listed during the quarter, now measured at quoted prices, with part of it under sale restrictions through October 2028. Non-marketable holdings carry cumulative upward remeasurements that rest on observable events identified by management. The partner lease guarantees are carried at fair value, with changes in other income. The ZT Systems contingent consideration was remeasured, and the facts do not give the sign. Goodwill rose with the MEXT acquisition and measurement-period adjustments; neither report gives an impairment test, headroom, discount rate or growth assumption. The calculator has no field for the unrealized gain, so no earnings adjustment can be written for it.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: No income-raising reserve release is visible in the trailing year, but most reserve evidence is missing. This quarter's pre-tax income carries a market-driven, non-operating gain, and the prior fiscal year carried a discrete tax-reserve release.

cost_deferral.finding: The record capitalises no software or development cost (the capitalised-development tags are absent). Research and development is expensed in full, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} over the trailing year and rising with headcount, which is conservative. The soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, the third lowest of six quarters and down year over year, and the fiscal 2025 share of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} was the second lowest of five years, so soft assets are not rising as a share of assets. Within them, other non-current assets rose sharply after year end, from gains on listed equity, purchases of long-term investments and supply-agreement prepayments. The prepayments were paid in cash through operating cash flow, so they do not flatter cash. Property and equipment rose sharply, from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment} a year earlier to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment}, with trailing capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier. Capital expenditure over depreciation cannot be computed because depreciation is missing for the period. On non-GAAP, the release's adjustments recur: acquisition-related and other costs appear every period and are defined more widely in the release than in the 10-Q, and a new loss-contingency adjustment for legal matters appeared this quarter. The release also removes the investment gain, which is the conservative direction. The non-GAAP gap is filled in no period, so whether it is widening cannot be said.
cost_deferral.verdict: No cost deferral is visible: development is expensed and the soft-asset share is not rising. Non-GAAP adjustments recur and a new one appeared, but the gap cannot be tracked over time.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: the trailing proceeds field is missing (the sale-of-receivables tags exist in the record but not for these periods), and neither report mentions such a programme. Supplier finance: never tagged and not mentioned; the payables build is explained as timing. Classification: the post-closing working-capital payment to Sanmina sits in the investing cash flows of discontinued operations, outside free cash flow, and supply-agreement prepayments sit in operating cash flow. Off-balance-sheet items have grown sharply. Unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, above the trailing year's cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}, and the note now describes multi-year cloud compute capacity purchased from cloud service providers. Guarantees of commercial partners' data-center leases carry a maximum exposure of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, with no balance on record a year earlier, and they may be issued in exchange for warrants. Long-term operating lease liabilities rose, and the calculator notes that the carried lease total of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} understates the current balance; more leases are signed but not yet commenced, and new data-center leases were signed after the quarter. Investment commitments signed after the quarter name no investee. Neither report mentions a variable-interest entity. Share-based compensation is a real cost: {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing year, {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of operating cash flow, and higher every year in the history, against repurchases of only {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}. It is already subtracted in the quality-adjusted free cash flow. That figure, {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}, is lifted by a data gap. The trailing acquisitions term is {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}, a negative number, because the fiscal 2025 line is missing ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.prior_fiscal_year}) while the year-ago six months carry {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.prior_year_to_date}, even though the notes say the ZT Systems business was acquired within fiscal 2025. One adjustment undoes that lift; a second removes the payables build that MD&A calls timing.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No receivables factoring or supplier finance is visible. Off-balance-sheet commitments have grown sharply: purchase obligations, partner lease guarantees, leases not yet on the balance sheet, and unnamed investment commitments. The pipeline's quality-adjusted free cash flow is overstated by an acquisitions data gap.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Disclosure controls are reported effective and internal control unchanged. The 10-Q carries no auditor's report, so an auditor change or critical audit matters cannot be checked; no material weakness is disclosed. No late-filing notice or amendment is listed. An 8-K carrying the officer-and-director-change item was filed after the quarter, but its body is in neither report, so whether a finance or accounting officer left cannot be said. On restatement: the year-end balance sheet carried in the 10-Q matches the 10-K on every fact the numbers reader could match. However, the 10-Q adds an unnamed prior-period reclassification; the current-debt and accrued-liability lines changed tags between the two filings; and pre-tax income rests on different tags in the 10-K and the 10-Q. Acquisition accounting already filed is still being revised: measurement-period adjustments to ZT Systems fed a post-closing working-capital payment to Sanmina, and discontinued operations still report results after the divestiture. The investment commitments and data-center leases signed after the quarter appear in no current report's item list. Retiring the treasury shares moved amounts out of additional paid-in capital and retained earnings without touching income or cash. Related-party purchases, payables and a term loan with an equity-method investee appear only as amounts, with no growth shown. Subsidiary-list changes and SEC comment letters are not in the input.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No control, auditor or restatement signal is visible. Open items: an unnamed prior-period reclassification, tag changes, continuing revisions to acquisition accounting already filed, material post-quarter undertakings with no current report, and an officer-change 8-K whose body is unseen.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release matches the 10-Q on every figure checked: quarterly revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, operating income of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}, net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, cash and short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now}, total debt of {terms.debt_now} and receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables}. The release's free cash flow is built on the same operating cash flow, and its GAAP gross margin agrees with {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}. The numbers contradict none of the notes items that carry a direction. They confirm the revenue growth, the gross-margin rise, the year-over-year net-income attribution, the gaming decline, the research and development increase, the other-income gain, the receivables increase, the prepayments, the divestiture payment, the acquisition goodwill and the treasury retirement. The rest are unresolved, either because they are segment claims with no segment numbers or because they look forward. The one contradiction sits in the pipeline's record rather than in the company's prose: the calculator carries no fiscal 2025 acquisitions line, although the notes say ZT Systems was acquired in that year. The documents differ in wording on four points. MD&A gives tax provision adjustments as the discontinued-operations cause, while the release gives measurement-period adjustments. The two define acquisition-related costs differently. The release carries a legal loss-contingency adjustment that the 10-Q contingencies note does not describe. And the release announces an Anthropic partnership that the 10-Q prose does not mention. Sequentially, net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} against operating income's {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, with the investment gain making up the difference, so MD&A's attribution to operating income holds year over year but less well quarter over quarter.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Release and 10-Q agree on the figures and no notes item is contradicted. The differences are in wording and in matters the release names but the 10-Q does not describe.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: annual days of inventory rose in every year of the history, from {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of five years. Quarterly days are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the third lowest of six and up year over year from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, a base cut by the export-control inventory charge. Inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} over the year. No reserve is tagged, and the prior-year charge shows the risk has already materialised once. Purchase commitments in excess of need: obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} exceed a full year's cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue} and grew from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}. Together with supply prepayments and cloud capacity that the providers may reduce, terminate or resell, they rest on the data-center ramp the release forecasts. Customer concentration: the top customer's share of receivables fell from {concentration.facts.1|pct} in fiscal 2024 to {concentration.facts.2|pct} in fiscal 2025, and the latest revenue-concentration fact is {concentration.facts.0|pct}, for fiscal 2023. The multi-gigawatt deployment agreements point to future concentration in a few AI customers. Channel stuffing: nothing found. Receivables grew more slowly than revenue year over year and semi-custom gaming revenue fell, the opposite of stuffing; the fourth quarter cannot be tested. Circular or vendor-financed deals are the main finding. The company gives OpenAI and Meta warrants that vest on GPU purchases. It guarantees commercial partners' data-center leases, possibly in exchange for warrants. After the quarter it signed investment commitments with an unnamed investee. It purchases multi-year cloud compute capacity from cloud service providers. And it announced a deployment partnership with Anthropic. The filings name no counterparty for the guarantees, the investment commitments or the leases, so the numbers cannot show whether money the company provides comes back as revenue.
industry_lens.verdict: The main concern is a cluster of arrangements in which the company finances, guarantees, invests in or purchases capacity from the counterparties of its data-center sales. Alongside it, purchase commitments exceed a year's cost of revenue and annual inventory days are at the top of the five-year range.

reconciliation.why: Quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year in the calculator, in line with the stated increase. The segment drivers have no segment numbers to test against.

Gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier, and that base, the lowest of six quarters, carries the export-control charge. Margin also rose sequentially from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, which fits the stated mix effect.

Operating income went from {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year.inputs.before} to {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}, while net income rose from {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.inputs.before} to {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}. The swing from a tax benefit to a tax charge worked against net income and the investment gain worked for it, so year over year operating income is the main driver. Sequentially, net income grew faster than operating income because of the gain.
Neither the numbers report nor the calculator has segment revenue. Total revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} is consistent with the claim but cannot isolate Data Center.

Segment operating income is not in the numbers. In total, operating income moved from a loss to {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}, and the year-ago base carries the charge, which is consistent but not a segment test.
The numbers include no unit shipments, average selling price or Client segment revenue.
The release's segment table, carried in the numbers report, shows Gaming revenue down against the year-ago quarter, matching the stated decline and its cause.
Segment operating income and segment operating expenses are not in the numbers.
Embedded segment revenue is not in the numbers.
Embedded segment operating income is not in the numbers.

Research and development rose against the year-ago quarter in the release figures and year over year in the annual facts; trailing expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}. The headcount cause cannot be tested.
Neither the numbers report nor the calculator carries marketing, general and administrative expense.
The intangible balance fell after year end, which fits ongoing amortization, but the numbers hold no year-ago amortization expense to show that it decreased.

The calculator holds only six-month interest expense, which rose from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date} to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}. That matches MD&A's six-month statement, but the quarter cannot be separated, and the claim's direction is for the quarter.
Other income rose against the year-ago quarter, and the release's cash-flow statement removes a gain on long-term investments of the same size that its non-GAAP reconciliation excludes.

The six-month cash-flow change of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.parts.this_year_to_date} matches the stated increase. Quarterly days sales outstanding fell year over year to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, so receivables grew more slowly than revenue; the sequential uptick is listed separately as an anomaly.

The release's cash-flow statement shows prepaid expenses and other assets absorbing cash this quarter, and other non-current assets rose after year end. The supplier identities and terms cannot be tested.

The build is confirmed by the six-month cash-flow change of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_payables.parts.this_year_to_date} and by payables of {terms.balances_now.accounts_payable}, but the predicted unwind belongs to next quarter, which the numbers cannot yet show.
The release's cash-flow statement carries the payment for the working-capital adjustment on the divestiture as a cash outflow in the quarter.
Goodwill rose after year end, and the six-month acquisitions outflow is {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.this_year_to_date}.
The commitments were signed after the quarter and are to be funded through fiscal 2028; no funding shows in the period's numbers.

Programme capacity is not a balance. Debt of {terms.debt_now} includes no commercial paper line, which fits the statement that none is outstanding, but the higher ceiling cannot be seen in the numbers.
These leases commence in 2027 and 2028, so they cannot yet appear among lease liabilities.

The claim concerns next quarter. Long-term operating lease liabilities have already risen after year end, and the calculator notes that the carried total of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} understates the current balance.
The release balance sheet shows treasury stock gone, and additional paid-in capital and retained earnings both lower than at year end, even though six-month net income was positive.

The effect is on future grants. Share-based compensation already rises every year in the history, to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing year, but the effect of the added shares cannot be seen yet.
This is forward-looking; the numbers cover no second-half quarter.
No number in either report relates to the partnership, and the 10-Q prose does not mention it.
This is forward-looking. The reported quarter grew {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} sequentially, but the guided quarter has not happened.
The numbers show a small discontinued-operations loss this quarter after a gain a year earlier, but they cannot say whether tax provision adjustments or measurement-period adjustments drive it.
The undertakings fall after the period, so no number bears on them; whether a current report was required is outside what the numbers can show.

Every year-end balance-sheet value the numbers reader matched is unchanged, but the current-debt and accrued-liability lines changed tags. The reclassified lines are not named, and parts of the input were not read.
The release prints the adjustment amount, but no number shows which components it holds under either definition.
Other income jumped, the release removes an investment gain, and other non-current assets rose after year end, all consistent with holdings now marked at quoted prices.
No number in either report isolates the non-marketable remeasurements.

The calculator carries a maximum guarantee exposure of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} at quarter end and none a year earlier, matching the note. The exposure first appears as a subsequent event in the 10-K.
The facility is undrawn, so no balance reflects it.

The rewording coincides with unconditional purchase obligations rising from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, which bears out that these commitments are now large.
No warrant liability or revenue reduction appears in the numbers, which is consistent with nothing having vested, but the effect on future revenue cannot be tested.
The release prints the adjustment, but the facts read hold no accrual for it, and the 10-Q note describes no matter; whether the gap matters turns on materiality.

anomalies.name_ko: 이익이 현금흐름보다 덜 출렁임
anomalies.what: Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, below one, so quarter-to-quarter changes in net income vary less than those in operating cash flow. The calculator gives no history of the measure. The plain reading is lumpy working capital in a fast-growing hardware business; no prose addresses it.

anomalies.name: Days sales outstanding up sequentially though down year over year
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 회전일수가 전년 대비로는 낮지만 직전 분기보다 상승
anomalies.what: Quarterly days sales outstanding rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of six quarters, while sequential revenue growth was {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct}. Receivables absorbed cash this quarter, where they released cash a year earlier. Year over year the measure fell from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, which supports MD&A's revenue explanation; the sequential part is not explained by revenue alone.

anomalies.name: Customer warrants tied to GPU purchases create a new revenue judgment
anomalies.name_ko: GPU 구매와 연동된 고객 워런트가 새로운 매출 인식 판단 영역을 만듦
anomalies.what: Warrants granted to OpenAI and Meta vest on Instinct GPU purchase milestones and stock-price targets. None had vested at quarter end, and they will be liability-classified once they do. Equity given to a customer in step with its purchases is consideration payable to a customer and may reduce the revenue recognised on those sales; no number shows it yet.

anomalies.name: Record gross margin with no visible inventory-reserve history
anomalies.name_ko: 재고충당금 이력이 보이지 않는 가운데 매출총이익률이 최고치
anomalies.what: Gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of six quarters, against a year-ago base of {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} that carried the export-control inventory charge. No inventory reserve is tagged in any period, and the trailing write-down field is missing. So the numbers cannot show whether previously written-down product was later sold, which would lift margin. MD&A names only the absence of the charge and a favourable mix.

anomalies.name: Unrealized gain on newly listed equity inside pre-tax income
anomalies.name_ko: 새로 상장된 지분의 미실현 평가이익이 세전이익에 포함됨
anomalies.what: Other income jumped against the year-ago quarter. The jump is mainly unrealized gains on non-marketable equity that became publicly traded and moved to quoted-price measurement, with part of the holding under sale restrictions through October 2028. The release removes the gain from non-GAAP income. From now on, quoted prices will move other income every quarter, in either direction. The calculator has no field for the gain, so no earnings adjustment is written.

anomalies.name: Upward remeasurements of non-marketable equity on management-identified events
anomalies.name_ko: 경영진이 식별한 관측 가능한 거래에 근거한 비상장 지분의 상향 재측정
anomalies.what: Non-marketable equity investments carry cumulative gross unrealized gains based on observable events or impairments that management identifies. That is a judgment-driven remeasurement that can raise income. The notes call the losses and impairments not material, and no number isolates the gains.

anomalies.name: Prior-year income lifted by a release of uncertain-tax-position reserves
anomalies.name_ko: 전년도 이익이 불확실 세무 충당금 환입으로 부풀려짐
anomalies.what: The year-ago quarter carried an income-tax benefit from releasing uncertain-tax-position reserves after IRS relief, and unrecognized tax benefits fell during fiscal 2025. Fiscal 2025 net income of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.net_income} exceeded operating income of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_income}. The trailing tax rate of {tax_rate|pct} excludes the release. This quarter's GAAP tax rate sits below the release's non-GAAP rate, and the cause is not stated.

anomalies.name: Warranty reserve ratio at a five-year high
anomalies.name_ko: 보증충당금 비율이 다섯 해 중 최고
anomalies.what: The warranty accrual over revenue reached {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} in fiscal 2025, the highest of five years, from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}. The direction is conservative, but it signals rising product exposure. No figure shows the accrual after year end, and no prose explains the rise.

anomalies.name: ZT Systems contingent consideration remeasured, sign unknown
anomalies.name_ko: ZT Systems 조건부 대가 재측정, 방향 불명
anomalies.what: The 10-K records a change in the ZT Systems contingent-consideration liability during fiscal 2025. The facts give neither its sign nor the balance, so whether the remeasurement raised income cannot be said.

anomalies.name: Other non-current assets and supply prepayments rising
anomalies.name_ko: 기타 비유동자산과 공급 선급금 증가
anomalies.what: Other non-current assets rose sharply after year end, from listed-equity gains, purchases of long-term investments and supply-agreement prepayments. The overall soft-asset share, {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, is still the third lowest of six quarters. The prepayments were cash paid through operating cash flow, so they defer cost to later inventory without flattering current cash; the suppliers and terms are not named.

anomalies.name: Property and equipment and capital spending well above the company's past
anomalies.name_ko: 유형자산과 설비투자가 과거 수준을 크게 웃돎
anomalies.what: Property and equipment went from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment} a year earlier to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment}. Trailing capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier. Capital expenditure over depreciation cannot be computed because depreciation is missing, so whether the useful-life assumptions defer cost cannot be tested.

anomalies.name: Recurring non-GAAP adjustments and a new legal-contingency exclusion
anomalies.name_ko: 반복되는 비GAAP 조정과 새로 생긴 소송 손실 조정
anomalies.what: Acquisition-related and other costs are excluded every period and defined more widely in the release than in the 10-Q. This quarter adds a loss contingency on legal matters, excluded from non-GAAP gross profit and operating income. The non-GAAP gap is filled in no period, so whether it is widening cannot be measured.

anomalies.name: Unconditional purchase obligations far above a year earlier
anomalies.name_ko: 무조건부 구매약정이 한 해 전보다 크게 늘어남
anomalies.what: Unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, above the trailing year's cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. The commitments note was reworded to describe multi-year cloud compute capacity purchased from cloud service providers, capacity those providers may reduce, terminate or sell to others.

anomalies.name: New guarantees of commercial partners' data-center leases
anomalies.name_ko: 상업 파트너의 데이터센터 임대에 대한 새 보증
anomalies.what: The maximum guarantee exposure is {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, with no balance on record a year earlier; it first appears as a subsequent event in the 10-K. The guarantees cover partners' data-center lease obligations with terms of up to fifteen years, become payable if a partner defaults, and may be issued in exchange for warrants. They are carried only at fair value, as a credit derivative whose changes run through other income.

anomalies.name: Lease commitments growing ahead of the balance sheet
anomalies.name_ko: 재무상태표에 아직 오르지 않은 임대 약정 증가
anomalies.what: Long-term operating lease liabilities rose after year end, and the calculator notes that the carried total of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} understates the current balance. Leases signed but not commenced moved their expected start from the second quarter to the second half of fiscal 2026, and new data-center leases signed after the quarter will commence in 2027 and 2028. All of these sit outside the balance sheet until commencement.

anomalies.name: Large investment commitments with an unnamed investee
anomalies.name_ko: 투자 대상이 밝혀지지 않은 대규모 투자 약정
anomalies.what: After the quarter the company entered investment commitments, subject to contingencies, to be made through fiscal 2028. The investee is not named. When funded, they will appear as purchases of long-term investments, outside free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Missing fiscal 2025 acquisitions line turns the acquisitions deduction into an addition
anomalies.name_ko: 2025 회계연도 인수 지출 누락으로 인수 차감 항목이 오히려 가산됨
anomalies.what: The trailing acquisitions term is {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}, a negative number: the fiscal 2025 line is {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.prior_fiscal_year}, while the year-ago six months, which fall inside fiscal 2025, carry {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.prior_year_to_date}. As a result, quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} is lifted above simple free cash flow less share-based compensation, instead of being reduced. The notes say the ZT Systems business was acquired in March 2025, inside fiscal 2025, which contradicts a zero fiscal 2025 acquisitions line.

anomalies.name: Working-capital true-up on the divestiture paid outside free cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 매각 관련 운전자본 정산금이 잉여현금흐름 밖에서 지급됨
anomalies.what: The company paid Sanmina a post-closing net working-capital adjustment, including effects of measurement-period adjustments, and classified it in the investing cash flows of discontinued operations. It is a real cash outflow tied to the ZT Systems business that free cash flow does not show. The calculator has no field for it.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation large, rising and barely offset by repurchases
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상비용이 크고 계속 늘며 자사주 매입으로 거의 상쇄되지 않음
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of operating cash flow and {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_revenue|pct} of revenue. It is higher every year in the history, from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.share_based_compensation} to {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation}, against trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}. The equity plan's share authorisation was raised this quarter. The cost is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Unnamed prior-period reclassification alongside tag changes
anomalies.name_ko: 어떤 항목인지 밝히지 않은 전기 재분류와 태그 변경
anomalies.what: A new sentence says certain prior-period amounts were reclassified, without naming them. Every year-end balance-sheet value the numbers reader matched is unchanged. The current portion of debt moved from a short-term-borrowings tag to a current-long-term-debt tag, accrued liabilities may have changed tags, and the calculator's pre-tax income rests on different tags in the 10-K and the 10-Q.

anomalies.name: Acquisition accounting already filed still being revised after the divestiture
anomalies.name_ko: 매각 이후에도 이미 공시한 인수회계가 계속 수정됨
anomalies.what: Measurement-period adjustments to the ZT Systems acquisition, a business acquired and then partly sold within fiscal 2025, appear in the goodwill table and in a working-capital payment to the purchaser of the manufacturing business. Discontinued operations still report results, a loss this quarter after a gain a year earlier.

anomalies.name: Material post-quarter undertakings with no matching current report
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 후 맺은 중요한 약정에 대응하는 수시공시가 없음
anomalies.what: The investment commitments and the long-term data-center leases signed after the quarter appear in no current report's item list: the 8-K filings made after the quarter carry only the officer-change item and the earnings-release items. The body of the officer-change 8-K is in neither report, so whether a finance or accounting officer left cannot be said.

anomalies.name: Treasury-share retirement reduces retained earnings outside income
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 소각으로 이익과 무관하게 이익잉여금 감소
anomalies.what: Retiring the treasury shares split the excess over par between additional paid-in capital and retained earnings. Both are lower than at year end despite positive income, and treasury stock no longer appears. The change touches neither earnings nor cash, but the movement in retained earnings no longer reflects income and distributions alone.

anomalies.name: Legal loss contingency in the release but not described in the 10-Q
anomalies.name_ko: 실적 발표에는 있으나 10-Q에는 설명되지 않은 소송 손실
anomalies.what: The release adds a loss contingency on legal matters to its reconciliations and to the Adjusted EBITDA definition. The 10-Q contingencies note only rolls its date forward and says there were no material legal proceedings, and the facts read hold no accrual for the matter.

anomalies.name: Anthropic deployment partnership announced in the release only
anomalies.name_ko: Anthropic 배치 제휴가 실적 발표에만 등장
anomalies.what: The release announces a strategic partnership with Anthropic to deploy Instinct GPUs in Helios racks. The 10-Q prose describes deployment agreements and warrants only for OpenAI and Meta, and names no counterparty for the guarantees, investment commitments or leases.

anomalies.name: Acquisition-related cost adjustment defined differently in the two documents
anomalies.name_ko: 인수 관련 비용 조정의 정의가 두 문서에서 다름
anomalies.what: The 10-Q segment note defines acquisition-related and other costs as mainly compensation charges and transaction costs. The release adds inventory fair-value adjustments and workforce rebalancing charges.

anomalies.name: Different stated causes of the discontinued-operations result
anomalies.name_ko: 중단영업 손익의 원인 설명이 문서마다 다름
anomalies.what: The 10-Q MD&A attributes the discontinued-operations result only to tax provision adjustments, while the release cites measurement-period adjustments, and the notes record a working-capital payment that includes measurement-period effects.

anomalies.name: Sequential net-income growth outruns operating income because of the gain
anomalies.name_ko: 순이익의 직전 분기 대비 증가가 투자이익 덕분에 영업이익 증가를 앞섬
anomalies.what: MD&A credits net-income growth primarily to operating income, and year over year that holds. Sequentially, net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} against operating income's {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, with the unrealized investment gain making up the difference.

anomalies.name: Annual inventory days rising every year to a five-year high
anomalies.name_ko: 연간 재고일수가 해마다 올라 다섯 해 중 최고
anomalies.what: Annual days of inventory rose in every year of the history, from {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}. Quarterly days are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, up year over year from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, a base cut by the export-control charge. The trailing measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}. No reserve is tagged, and MD&A names no inventory driver.

anomalies.name: Supply and capacity commitments running ahead of the cost base
anomalies.name_ko: 공급·용량 약정이 원가 규모를 앞질러 늘어남
anomalies.what: Purchase obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} exceed a year's cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. Supply-agreement prepayments are rising, and the cloud compute capacity commitments are ones the company expects to use or assign to third parties. All of it rests on the data-center ramp the release forecasts; if demand falls short, losses on commitments would follow.

anomalies.name: Cluster of arrangements that finance, guarantee or purchase capacity from sales counterparties
anomalies.name_ko: 판매 상대방에게 자금·보증·투자를 제공하거나 그들로부터 용량을 사들이는 거래가 겹침
anomalies.what: Several arrangements run in both directions. Warrants to OpenAI and Meta vest on GPU purchases. Guarantees of partners' data-center leases, with maximum exposure of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, may be issued in exchange for warrants. Investment commitments with an unnamed investee were signed after the quarter. Multi-year cloud compute capacity is purchased from cloud service providers. And a deployment partnership with Anthropic was announced. The filings name no counterparty for the guarantees, investment commitments or leases, so the numbers cannot show whether money the company provides returns as revenue.

anomalies.name: Receivables concentration down but deployment agreements concentrate future sales
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 집중도는 낮아졌으나 대형 배치 계약이 향후 매출을 소수 고객에 집중시킴
anomalies.what: The top customer's share of receivables fell from {concentration.facts.1|pct} in fiscal 2024 to {concentration.facts.2|pct} in fiscal 2025. The latest revenue-concentration fact on record is {concentration.facts.0|pct}, for fiscal 2023. Multi-gigawatt deployment agreements with OpenAI and Meta, and the Anthropic partnership, point to sales concentrating in a few AI customers.

anomalies.name: Gaming revenue down sharply on lower semi-custom sales
anomalies.name_ko: 세미커스텀 매출 감소로 게이밍 매출 급감
anomalies.what: Gaming revenue fell against the year-ago quarter on lower semi-custom revenue, unlike the rest of the business. A falling line in a customer-specific business is the opposite of channel stuffing.

adjustments.name: Remove the payables build that the company attributes to timing of payment obligations
adjustments.quote: partially offset by a $2.2 billion increase in accounts payable primarily due to timing of payment obligations

adjustments.name: Undo the negative trailing acquisitions term created by the missing fiscal 2025 acquisitions line, which adds phantom cash to quality-adjusted free cash flow
adjustments.quote: Together they revise acquisition accounting already filed for a business acquired in March 2025 and sold in October 2025.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로 이익이 현금으로 뒷받침되지만, 지난 회계연도의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배보다는 여유가 줄었습니다. 이번 분기 영업현금흐름 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.0}은 순이익 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0}과 거의 같고, 회사가 지급 시점 때문이라고 설명한 매입채무 증가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}에 기대고 있습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권 회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 한 해 전 분기의 {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일보다 낮아, 매출채권이 매출보다 빨리 늘고 있지는 않습니다. 다만 직전 분기보다는 올랐고, OpenAI와 Meta에 준 워런트가 앞으로 매출을 얼마나 인식할지에 대한 새 판단 영역이 됩니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금과 재고충당금 자료가 없어 충당금이 얇아지는지는 확인할 수 없고, 보증충당금 비율은 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}로 다섯 해 중 가장 높습니다. 이번 분기 세전이익에는 새로 상장된 지분의 미실현 평가이익이 들어 있고, 2025 회계연도 순이익 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.net_income}에는 불확실 세무 충당금 환입이 포함되어 있었습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 보이지 않고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용으로 처리되며, 무형·기타 자산 비중 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}도 늘지 않았습니다. 다만 비GAAP 조정 항목이 매 분기 반복되고, 이번 분기에는 소송 손실 조정이 새로 생겼습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 보이지 않지만, 구매약정이 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}에서 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}로 늘고 파트너 데이터센터 임대 보증 {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}이 새로 생기는 등 재무상태표 밖 약정이 크게 불었습니다. 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}은 인수 지출 자료 누락으로 생긴 음수 인수 항목 {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} 때문에 부풀려져 있어, 이를 되돌리는 조정을 넣었습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 보고되었고, 감사인 교체나 재무제표 재작성 신호는 보이지 않습니다. 다만 어떤 항목인지 밝히지 않은 전기 재분류, 계정 태그 변경, ZT Systems 인수회계의 사후 수정, 수시공시 없는 분기 후 대형 약정이 남아 있습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표의 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}은 10-Q와 일치하고, 숫자가 주석 설명을 반박하는 항목은 없습니다. 차이는 중단영업 원인 설명, 인수 관련 비용 정의, 소송 손실 조정, Anthropic 제휴 언급 같은 문구에 있습니다.
